The .NET 10 ProductCatalog library has a synchronous CatalogCache and ProductCardReader. Add ordered bulk retrieval to the reader. Preserve the existing APIs and their behavior. Concurrency is out of scope.

Add public sealed record CardReadResult(string? RequestedKey, ProductCard? Card, string? Error) and public IReadOnlyList<CardReadResult> ProductCardReader.ReadMany(IEnumerable<string?> keys). Throw ArgumentNullException for a null collection. Enumerate it once, preserve order, and return one result per occurrence. A successful result has Error null, its original RequestedKey and a ProductCard with the original key spelling and loaded description. Null, empty, and whitespace-only keys produce "invalid-key" and no Card. A CatalogUnavailableException from the loader produces "unavailable" and no Card. Any other exception propagates.

Match the single reader's lookup behavior: trim each valid key for the cache lookup. Within one ReadMany call, keys that trim to the same value with ordinal case-sensitive comparison share the first outcome, including an unavailable outcome. Their returned spelling still follows the corresponding input. A failure is not memoized across calls. Preserve cache expiration (entries are fresh strictly before 30 seconds after successful load completion), invalidation, and existing exception behavior.

Keep the library buildable with the installed SDK and no external packages.
